headline: Approved fortune teller license at 24 Crescent St. and extended hours renewal for CVS at 12 Harvard St.
summary: The minutes of the October 5, 2026 meeting were also approved. All three votes were by voice vote, and Katz was absent.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the 10/5/2026 meeting by voice vote.
Approved the Fortune Tellers License at 24 Crescent St Ste. 401F for Minwoo Park by voice vote.
Approved the Extended Hours Renewal at 12 Harvard St for CVS Pharmacy #114 by voice vote.

plain_text:
Licenses & Franchises Committee
Meeting Minutes
October 19, 2026
The Chair called the meeting to order at 7:45 p.m. 
The Clerk called the roll.
Present: Brasco, Vidal, Logan, and Tzioumis. 
Absent: Katz.
Charlie Johnson from The Waltham Times was recording the meeting.
Councillor Brasco moved approval of the 10/5/2026 minutes. The motion was approved by a 
voice vote.
First agenda item: Fortune Tellers License at 24 Crescent St Ste. 401F for Minwoo Park
Councillor Logan spoke and moved for approval of the license. The motion was approved by a 
voice vote.
Second agenda item: Extended Hours Renewal at 12 Harvard St for CVS Pharmacy #114
Councillor Brasco moved approval of the license. The motion was approved by a voice vote.
With no further matters Councillor Brasco moved to adjourn.
Chairman Vidal declared the meeting adjourned at 7:48 p.m.
Respectfully submitted,
Kara Wilson, Clerk of the Licenses & Franchises Committee
October 20, 2026
